events.title: Tupac Shakur's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas, aged 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, who left us far too soon on this day in '96. His music continues to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away, he would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Paying tribute to the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who redefined what a guitar could do. Still inspiring generations, 56 years on.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is your go-to from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking, still relevant, and still sounding incredible.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track he's on?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Released
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Forty-one years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: The Click Wheel Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, it changed everything about carrying your music. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Visionary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. Which of its diverse tracks is your hidden gem?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the incomparable Freddie Mercury passed away, he would have been 80.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost one of music's greatest showmen. His voice still gives us chills.

events.title: The Beatles Release 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A pivotal album that influenced countless artists.

events.title: John Lennon's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the loss of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we tragically lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.
